$comment: EXAMPLE aidlc.lock for an install that chose the test-pro plugin. Written by `aidlc plugin add test-pro` (the installer is future work — doc 21 §B.6). Pins everything that determines the composed result, so `aidlc plugin sync` reproduces a byte-identical install on another machine. The sha256 values below are ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders.

composer.$comment: the AIDLC composer that produced this install (doc 21 §B.7)

core.$comment: bare-core version + content hash — the base every install starts from

test-pro.$comment: source git SHA + content hash of the fetched plugin tree

result.$comment: content hash of the composed effective install (core + test-pro). sync asserts the recomposed tree matches this.
